newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Georgia to get new state-owned airline-minister.
newsitem.headline: Georgia to get new state-owned airline-minister.

text.p: Georgia has set up a new state carrier named Airways of Georgia (Sakartvelos Aviakhazebi), a transport minister said on Thursday.
Merab Adeishvili told Reuters the new carrier would begin operations in July.
He said the airline would have a fleet of German and French-made aircraft but did not name the type of planes and routes the company would service.
Adeishvili said that private Orbi Georgian Airlines may soon go out of business because of financial troubles.

Orbi was founded in 1991 from the break up of the former Soviet monopoly Aeroflot. It has been operating five Tupolev Tu-154 jets, with regular and charter flights to Russia and the former Soviet Union. --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 85 20
